title: קבל
content:
קבל (√ of following, be in front of).

[Str6903] קֳבֵל:29 subst. front, as prep. in front of, before, because of; sq. דִּי as conj. because that (perh. in form a dimin., Bev:Dn 2:8; Targum קְבֵיל, c. לְ, לִקְבֵיל, sf. לְקִבֵלִי, etc., in front of (Dalm.:§ 47, 7); Syr. ܩܒܘܠ, ܩܘܒܠܐ aspect, ܡܢ ܩܒܘܠ in front, ܠܩܘܒܠ, sf. ܠܩܘܒܠܗ in front (of), opposite (to), cf. Gn 15:10 Targum SyrVer; Palm. לקבל before (Cooke321, cf.193));—cstr. לָקֳבֵל Dn 2:8 +, sf. לְקָבְלָךְ † 2:31;—† 1. c. לְ a. Dn 3:3 צַלְמָא ´לק: before the image, 2:31, 5:1, 5:5; in view of, by reason of, 5:10 מַלְכָּא ´מִלֵּ :´לק: by reason of the words, etc., Ezr 4:16 לָקֳבֵל דְּנָה (cf. Eg. Aram. לקבל זנה זי, RES361 B5). b. sq. דִּי as conj. because that Ezr 6:13 (so Palm. CISii. 164). 2. c. כֹּל, כָּל־קֳבֵל in view of, because of (but read probably כְּלָקֳבֵל according to the front of, i.e. having regard to, because of : LuzzChald. Gr. § 123 LambertRÉJ, 1895, 47 f. Marti:§ 95 d NöLCB, 1896, 703 NesOLZ, 1902, 487 Strack56 al.; cf. BH I. עֻמָּה d): a. as prep. כָּל־קֳבֵל דְּנָה because of this, therefore, † Dn 2:12, 2:24, 3:7, 3:8, 6:10, Ezr 7:17, Dn 3:22 pointing forwards, ´כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּנָה דִּנָה מִן־דִּי וג: on this account, (viz.) because that, etc. b. sq. דִּי as conj. because that, inasmuch as, Dn 2:8 דִּי חֲזֵיתוּן (כְּלָקֳבֵל)כָּל־קֳבֵל because ye see, v:10, v:41, v:45 +, Ezr 4:14, 7:14; Dn 5:22 = although. In Dn 2:40, 6:11 taken by LXX (ὅν τρόπον, καθώς), Ges (Thes, not Lex), Ew Hi as = according as (as Ec 5:15 Targum כל קבל דאתא according as he came), but not Bev Behrm Marti. [Occas. in Targum, usu. = before; cf. in TargumJ Gn 28:17, 31:32, D§§ 47.7; 50].

[Str6901–02] † קַבֵּל vb. denom. Pa. receive (BH (late), (q.v.; Targum Syr.: prop. come in front of, come to meet, cf. Germ. entgegennehmen);—Pf. 3 ms. קַבֵּל Dn 6:1; Impf. 2 mpl. תְּקַבְּלוּן ye shall receive 2:6, 3 mpl. וִיקַבְּלוּן 7:18; all c. acc. rei.

[Str6925] קֳדָם:42 prep. before (so OAram. Nab. Palm. etc. (Lzb360 f.), Targum קָדָם, Syr. ܩܕܡ; prop. a subst. the front, cf. Ar. قُدَّام the front; for √ v. BH קדם);—sf. קָדָמַי Dn 2:9 +, מָי- v:6; קדמיך Kt, קֳדָמָךְ Qr, † 5:23, 6:23; קֳדָמוֺהִי 4:5 + (cf. Nerab קדמוה, Cooke189); 3 fs. קדמיה Kt, קֳדָמַהּ Qr, † 7:7, 7:8, 7:20; קֳדָמֵיהוֺן † 4:4;—1. before (= Heb. לפְנֵי), esp. in the phrases to answer, pray, say, etc., before a superior (as more respectful than to), Dn 2:9 לְמֵאמַד קֳדָמַי, v:10, v:11, v:27, 6:11 (v. Dr), v:12, v:13, v:14; ´קֱרִי ק: Ezr 4:18, 4:23, 5:23, 5:23; with שְׁפַר to seem fair Dn 3:32, 6:2; after vbs. of motion, in before, Dn 2:24, 2:25, 3:13, 4:3 +; of time 7:7. † 2. מִן־קֳדָם from before ( = מִלִּפְנֵי, but as used in late Heb., Est 1:19, 4:8: p. 818a), c. קַבֵּל Dn 2:6, בְּעָא v:18; of a decree, 6:27 מִן־קֳדָמִי שִֹׁים טְעֵם (‖מִנִּי 3:29 +), cf. 2:15, Ezr 7:14; of God, Dn 5:24 מִן־קֳדָמוֺהִי שְׁלִיחַ פַּסָּא דַּי־יְדָא, 7:10 (so very oft. in Targum, DrSm lxx. f. lxxiii). Also = Heb. מִפְּנֵי, with to fear Dn 5:19, 6:27, be rooted up 7:8, fall v:20.

[Str6927–28] † [קַדְמָה] n.f. former time (cf. BH קַדְמָה, Zinj. קדמה (Cooke177), former state);—cstr. Dn 6:11 מִן־קַּדְמַת דְּנָה = before this, formerly; so Ezr 5:11 ´מִקַּדְמַת דְּ:. Cf. Gn 28:19 TargumJ, Ez 38:17 Targum.

[Str6933] † [קַדְמָי] adj. former, first (so Nab. Palm. Targum Syr.);—fs. emph. קַדְמָֽיְתָא the first Dn 7:4, fpl. emph. קַרְנַיָּא קַדְמָיָתָא the former horms v:8, mpl. emph. קַדְמָיֵא v:24.

title: קדשׁ
content:
[Str6918] קדשׁ (√ of foll.; Targum Syr.; v. BH id., קָדוֺשׁ).

[Str6922] † קַדִּישׁ adj. holy;—abs. ´ק: Dn 4:10, 4:20; pl. שִׁין- 4:5 +, cstr. שֵׁי- 7:18 +;—gods Dn 4:5, 4:6, 4:15, 5:11; as subst., of angels 4:10, 4:14, 4:20; of Isr. (as holy ones, saints) 7:21, 7:22, קַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֺנִין saints of the Most High v:18, v:22, v:25, v:27.

title: קול
content:
[Str6963] קול (√ of following; BH קול, קוֺל).

[Str7032] † קָל n.m.:Dn 4:28 voice (Targum Syr.);—´ק: abs. Dn 4:28, 6:21; cstr. sound of words 7:11, instr. 3:5, 3:7, 3:10, 3:15.

title: קוּם
content:
[Str6965–66] [קוּם] vb. arise, stand (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. קָם Dn 3:24, 3 mpl. קָ֫מוּ Ezr 5:2; Impf. 3 ms. יְקוּם Dn 6:20, 7:24, 3 fs. תְּקוּם 2:39, 2:44; 3 mpl. יְקוּמוּן 7:10, 7:17, 7:24 (´יְקֻ:); Pt. קָאֵם 2:31, pl. קאמין Kt, קָֽיְמִין Qr, 3:3, emph. קָֽאֲמַיָּא 7:16;—1. lit. arise Dn 3:24 (i.e. from throne), 6:20 (from bed). 2. fig. = come on the scene of history: of kingdom 2:39, king 7:17, 7:24 (both מִן of source), v:24. 3. arise (out of inaction), and build Ezr 5:2, devour Dn 7:5b. 4. stand, lit., לָקֳבֵל Pers. 2:31, cf. 3:3, קֳדָם Pers. 7:10; pt. as n., those standing (there) v:16. 5. endure, kingdom 2:44. Pa. set up, establish an ordinance (קְיָם): Inf. לְקַיָּמָה 6:8. Haph. (K§ 45, 4) Pf. 3 ms. הֲקֵים Dn 3:2 +, וַהֲקִים 6:2, sf. הֱקִימֵהּ 5:11, אֲקִימֵהּ 3:1; 3 fs. הֱקִמַת 7:5; 2 ms. הֲקֵימְתּ 3:12, 3:18; 1 s. הֲקֵ֫ימֶת לָא 3:14; Impf. 3 ms. יְהָקֵים (K§ 45, b)) 5:21, 6:16, יְקִים 2:44, 4:14; Inf. sf. לַהֲקָמוּתֵהּ 6:4; Pt. act. מְהָקֵים 2:21;—1. set up, lit. image 3:1, 3:2, 3:3, 3:3, 3:5, 3:7, 3:12, 3:14, 3:18; fig. kings 2:21, kingdom v:44. 2. lift up one side 7:5 a (Dr). 3. establish, c. acc. קְיָם 6:16 (= Pa.), אֱסָרָא v:9. 4. appoint Ezr 6:18, 2 acc. Dn 5:11; sf. Pers. + עַל 6:4, ל acc. Pers. + עַל 4:14, 5:21, 6:2. Hoph. Pf. 3 fs. הֳקִימַת (variants in Str; cf. K§ 45, 5; not Hebraism NöGGA 1867, 1784; WCG 225, 253) 7:4 be made to stand עַלרַגְיִן.

[Str7010] † קְיָם n.[m.] statute (Eg. Aram. קימיהם Cooke209);— abs. Dn 6:16, cstr. v:8.

[Str7011] † קַיָּם adj. enduring (cf. Nab. קים (Cooke217 Lzb קָיֵם; SAC, privately, prob. קַיָּם));—abs. ´ק: Dn 6:27 (of God, so oft. Targum NH, cf. Dr); fs. קַיָּמָה 4:23 (of kingdom).

title: קְטַל
content: [Str6991–92] † [קְטַל] vb. slay (Targum Syr. (oft.); v. BH (late, rare));—Pe. Pt. act. קָטֵל Dn 5:19, acc. Pers. Pe‘îl be slain: Pf. 3 ms. קְטִיל 5:30, 3 fs. קְטִילַת 7:11. Pa. slay: Pf. 3 ms. קַטִּל 3:22 (acc. Pers.); Inf. לְקַטָּלָה 2:14 (ל acc. Pers.). Hithpe. be slain: Inf. לְהִתְקְטָלָה 2:13; Pt. (= gerundive, K§ 76, 3) pl. מִתְקַטְלִין v:13 were to be slain.

title: קטר
content:
[Str7000] קטר (√ of foll.; Targum קְטַר, Syr. ܩܛܪ bind, whence קִטְרָא, ܩܛܪܐ knot, etc.; cf. BH II. [קטר]).

[Str7001] † [קְטַר] n.m.:Dn 5:6 joint, knot;—lit. pl. cstr. קִטְרֵי Dn 5:6 joints of his loin; fig. abs. קִטְרִין v:12, v:16, usu. knotty things, difficulties (Syr. PS3591); but prob. of magic spells, banns (also Syr. PS1. c., cf. Brock319 b), so Bev, v. also Dr.

[Str7007,7019] † קַ֫יִט n.[m.] summer (Targum Syr.; v. BH II. קיץ);—abs. ´ק: Dn 2:35.

[Str7010–11] קְיָם, קְיָּם v. קום. above

[Str7030] † פיתרס Kt, קַתְרֹס Qr, n.[m.] lyre, zither (also Targum; loan-word from Gk. κίθαρις Kraussi. 193: ii. 573);—Dn 3:5, 3:7, 3:10, 3:15; Kmp קִיתָרִם.

title: קָל
content: [Str7032] קָל v. קול

title: קְנָא
content: [Str7066,7069] † [קְנָא] vb. acquire, buy (v. BH I. קנה);—Pe. Impf. 2 ms. תִּקְנֵא Ezr 7:17 c. acc. rei, + בְּכַסְפָּא.

title: קצא
content:
[Str7097] קצא (√ of following; BH I. קצה, קָצֶה).

[Str7117–18] † קְצָת n.f. end (so BH (late); Targum (Gn 47:2); not Syr.; cf. Eg. Aram. RÉS361 A 4);—cstr. ´לִק: at the end of (months, days) 4:26, 4:31; מַלְכוּתָא ´מִן־ק: 2:42 = part of (‖מִנַּהּ vd; cf. BH קְצָת 2).

title: קְצַף
content:
[Str7108] † קְצַף vb. be wroth (Syr.; v. BH I. קצף);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´ק: Dn 2:12.

[Str7109] ‡ † קְצַף n.[m.] wrath (of God) (only Syr. ܩܨܦܐ sadness, anxiety, in Lexx.);—abs. ´ק: Ezr 7:23.

[Str7118] קְחָת v. קצא. above

title: קְרָא
content: [Str7123,7121] † [קְרָא] vb. call, read out, aloud (v. BH I. קרא);—Pe. Impf. 3 ms. יִקְרֵה Dn 5:7, 1 S. אֶקְרֵא v:17; 3 mpl. קִקְרוֺן v:15; Inf. לְמִקְרֵא v:8, v:16; Pt. act. קָרֵא 3:4 + ;—1. call, proclaim, בְּהַיִל: Dn 3:4, 4:11, 5:7 2. read out, aloud, acc. כְּתָבָא 5:7, 5:8, 5:15, 5:16, v:17 (ל Pers.). Pe‘îl (WCG 225) Pf. 3 ms. קֱרִי Ezr 4:18, 4:23 it was read, קֳדָם Pers. Hithpe. be summoned, Impf. 3 ms. יִתְקְרֵי Dn 5:12.

title: קְרֵב
content:
[Str7126–27] † קְרֵב vb. approach (v. BH I. קרב);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´ק: Dn 3:26 (ל loc.); 1 s. קִרְבַת 7:16 (עַל Pers.); abs., 3 mpl. קְרִ֫בוּ Dn 3:8, 6:13; Inf. sf. כְּמִקְרְבֵהּ 6:21 when he approached, ל loc. Pa. offer sacrifice: Impf. 2 ms. תְּקָרֵב Ezr 7:17, c. acc. + עַל of altar. Haph. 1. = Pa.: c. acc. Pf. 3 mpl. הַקְרִ֫בוּ Ezr 6:17, Pt. act. מְהַקְבִין v:10 (ל dei). 2. bring near: Pf. sf. הַקְרְבוּהִי Dn 7:13 (קֳדָם dei).

[Str7129,7128] † קְרָב (K§ 57 a)) n.[m.] war (Targum Syr. NH id.; BH as Aramaism);—abs. Dn 7:21.

[Str7149,7151] † קִרְיָה, אָ֯, n.f. city (Targum Syr.; S-CA 9 + קריה; v. BH, √ קרה; also NöBeitr. 62);—abs. הָ֯ Ezr 4:10, אָ֯ v:15; emph. קִרְיְתָא v:12, v:13, v:15, v:15, v:16, v:19, v:21

[Str7161–62] † קֶ֫רֶן n.f.:Dn 7:8 horn (v. BH קרן);—abs. ´ק: Dn 7:8; emph. קַרְנָא 3:5 + ; du. (often !) קַרְנַ֫יִן 7:7; emph. נַיָּא- 7:8 + ;—1. instr. of music, Dn 3:5, 3:7, 3:10, 3:15. 2. symbolic, in vision, 7:7, 7:8, 7:8, 7:8, 7:11, 7:20, 7:20, 7:21, 7:24.

[Str7170–71] [קְרַץ] n.[m.] piece (Targum; v. BH קרץ);—pl. sf. קַרְצ֫וֺהִי Dn 6:25, צֵיהוֺן- 3:8, both in phr. ´אֲכַ֫לוּ ק:, i.e. accuse maliciously (so Targum Syr. PS3756 (cf. OAram. ´אמר כרצי פ: Lzb299 SAC66 Cooke205 f.; כרץ also Mand.), prob. borrowed from As. karṣe akâlu, malign, slander (oft.; also TelAm.); cf. also uḳtarrizu ḪammLaw 161; further Ar. أَكَلَ لَحمَهُ id., and kindred phr.; Eth. በሊእ፡ ሽገ፡ DI489).

[Str7187,7189] † קְשֹׁט n.[m.] truth (Targum Syr.; v. BH קשְׁטְ once, Aramaism));—abs. Dn 4:34; ´מִן־ק: 2:47 of a truth.

[Str7030] קַתְרֹס v. קיתרס. p. 1111
